{{MEinfobox
|name=Poise
|cg=Poise.png}}
{{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} is a Status Effect that is gained through Skills and gives attacks a chance to deal a Critical Hit, increasing damage dealt by 20%. The chance for a Critical Hit is dependent on {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Potency (Crit chance = (Potency * 5)%), while {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Count decreases by 1 on a Critical Hit (identical timing as On Hit) and by 1 at Turn End. 

{{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} is linked to the {{Icons|Pride}}Pride Sin Affinity.

==Strengths & Weaknesses==
{{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} is a finicky buff effect. Increasing Potency effectively increases the rate at which Poise is spent, meaning that it is very difficult to have both high Poise Potency and high Poise Count without E.G.O Gifts. While some Identities only gain {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Count and convert it into Potency with their third Skill, most Identities gain more Potency than Count. This can result in Poise expiring before an attack can Crit. Because {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Identities are generally unable to share Poise among teammates, they can be placed on any team. There exists a small handful of E.G.O that share Poise between teammates, which are typically the core of a Poise team: Identities that are capable of providing {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} support to allies through their own kits are quite rare and typically come with caveats (such as only applying to Identities of a specific faction).

If an Identity gains 20 or more {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Potency, their critical hit chance is fixed at 100%. This means additional Poise potency becomes essentially useless unless it is consumed by certain passives or E.G.O. Gifts.

Due to {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} being consumed '''per coin''' if the hit was successful, a lack of {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Count makes it hard to build up Potency and land constant Critical Hits with skills that have many coins. This can result in an Identity's Poise stack resetting, preventing high values of Poise potency from being gained. To avoid this, certain Identities gain a set amount of {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} when using certain skills, allowing at least that skill to have critical hits.

{{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} is particularly strong in Mirror Dungeons or Encounters where Identities can get multiple Skill Slots, and generally suffers in [[Refraction Railway]] or in boss fights due to the inability to build Poise quickly and deal high damage in these game modes compared to other Status Effects. This is largely due to the crit multiplier being low (+20%) and team Poise generation dependent on a few key Identities and E.G.O. {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} is the most effective when capitalizing against damage type weaknesses due to Poise damage being multiplicative rather than fixed. A {{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} team is also often a {{Icons|Pride}}'''Pride [[Resonance]] Team''' due to {{Icons|Pride}}Pride skills being very common among Poise Identities.

{{StatusEffect|Poise|b}} Identities often need Uptie IV to increase their Poise Count generation. Without it, some Identities are barely able to benefit from their Poise outside of Mirror Dungeons.
